reuse.why: All four steps go through the existing shared getScheduledAmount (now also used by the API model and schedule-template) and reuse getApproxNumberThreshold for the approximate tolerance.

duplication.why: Removes the separate midpoint computation in schedule-template.ts by routing it through getScheduledAmount; the expectedAmount field calls the same helper instead of restating the rule.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the API field in the scheduleModel mapper in api-models.ts and the type in api-handlers, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: Edits are the rule, the call sites that must now pass the operator, the API field, tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: One definition used everywhere with good tests; minor nits are the loosely typed op: string and inserting op positionally before the existing inverse flag.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every caller, including the formerly divergent schedule-template.ts, calls getScheduledAmount with the schedule's operator.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the API expectedAmount delegates to getScheduledAmount.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains the op parameter and an isapprox branch for the tolerance, which are the real variation of the rule; no caller bypasses it (schedule-template's own midpoint was removed).
